extension_points: Scheduler setup and cleanup remain game-owned.
Tick rules, rendering, and terminal conditions remain game-owned.
boundaries.shared_core: The shared loop caps the elapsed delta at 50 milliseconds before passing it to an active game tick.

extension_points: Result payload fields and formulas remain game-owned.
Victory and defeat predicates remain game-owned.
boundaries.shared_core: A completion guard permits no more than one host completion emission for an accepted terminal session.

extension_points: The game may impose stronger content-count requirements.
The game owns its validation error wording.
boundaries.shared_core: State creation validates that vocabulary contains at least one item before a playable state can exist.

extension_points: Round duration, travel timing, and miss penalties are game-owned.
Boss sequencing, presentation, and result payloads are game-owned.
boundaries.shared_core: A round binds one term, one correct translation, one decoy, and a correct left-or-right side; selection resolves correctness and advances the bounded session state.

extension_points: State literals and intermediate phases are game-owned.
Victory, defeat, pause, and restart transition predicates are game-owned.
boundaries.shared_core: A session exposes distinguishable pre-play, active, and terminal conditions so hosts can start, run, finish, and restart it.

extension_points: Bindings, gesture thresholds, and action names are game-owned.
Phase guards, debouncing, and accessibility affordances are game-owned.
boundaries.shared_core: Host input is translated into a small game action vocabulary before domain state is updated.

extension_points: Prompt shape, distractors, and ordering rules are game-owned.
Correctness consequences, attempt rules, and completion thresholds are game-owned.
boundaries.shared_core: The game compares an interaction with a current language target, records correctness, and conditionally advances ordered progress.

extension_points: Difficulty names, aliases, defaults, and tier counts are game-owned.
Speeds, timers, counts, multipliers, and penalties are game-owned.
boundaries.shared_core: A named difficulty selection resolves to a coherent set of tuning parameters consumed by game rules.

extension_points: Formulas, units, rounding, caps, and bonuses are game-owned.
Result payload shape and display fields are game-owned.
boundaries.shared_core: Terminal session counters are converted into a stable result value for the host and result surface.

extension_points: Tick cadence, timer direction, cooldowns, and spawn intervals are game-owned.
Timeout effects and time-based terminal conditions are game-owned.
boundaries.shared_core: An active update consumes bounded elapsed time and advances one or more time-dependent state values.

extension_points: Collision geometry, invulnerability, and hit ordering are game-owned.
Resource types, damage values, rescue effects, and terminal thresholds are game-owned.
boundaries.shared_core: A detected interaction is guarded, resolved once for that update, and translated into an evidenced resource or entity consequence.

extension_points: Coordinate systems, lanes, bounds, and camera transforms are game-owned.
Velocity, gravity, animation, and world-generation rules are game-owned.
boundaries.shared_core: One active update maps intent and elapsed time onto bounded actor or world state.

extension_points: Copy, art, sound, layout, animation, and semantic labels are game-owned.
The exact HUD metrics and start, error, or result surfaces are game-owned.
boundaries.shared_core: The presentation reads authoritative session state and exposes timely status or feedback to the player and host.
